basic_profile.bio: Enthusiastic newcomer to Reddit from the Pacific Northwest, juggling a career in customer support with a passion for digital art and gaming. Avid fan of The Sims 2 and an aspiring digital artist, often found sharing art on DeviantArt and discussing gaming strategies on Reddit. Enjoys exploring new mobile tech deals, especially those related to cell plans. Single and enjoys spending late evenings online, usually after a long day's work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught digital artist with a background in customer support. Gained expertise in mobile technologies and service plans through personal research and professional experience in the telecommunications industry.
